title: Score After Flipping Matrix
description: Flip rows/columns to maximize the score represented by binary rows.
pseudocode:
1. For each row, flip if first element is 0
2. For each col, flip if count of 0s > count of 1s
3. Calculate total sum

steps.note: Ensure first column is all 1s by flipping rows starting with 0
Row 1 starts with 1, no flip needed
Checking column 1. Two 1s, one 0. No flip needed
Calculating total: row 0 is 10(2), row 1 is 11(3). Total = 5
